components.description: Therapeutic-area abbreviation (2–6 characters). e.g. SCLC, TB, ONC, CVD, ID
Topic abbreviation (3–4 characters). e.g. DIS (Disease burden), EFF (Efficacy), SAF (Safety), POS (Positioning), EDU (Patient education), UNM (Unmet need)
Zero-padded 3-digit sequence within TA+TOPIC namespace, e.g. 001, 002, 012

fields.description: Follows TA-TOPIC-NNN convention. Immutable once approved.
HCP | Patient | Caregiver | MSL | Payer | Regulator | Public | Media
The single scientific point this card exists to communicate
The verbatim message, phrased for the primary audience
Data points, tables, figures that substantiate the message
Mandatory fair-balance framing (e.g. subgroup restrictions, contraindications, safety trade-offs). Compliance-critical.
Visual asset suggestion (forest plot, Kaplan-Meier, infographic, patient journey diagram)
Channels where this card can be deployed (LinkedIn, HCP portal, MSL detail aid, congress poster, patient blog, etc.)

approvedBy.description: MA Team Lead or delegated approver

expiryDate.description: Card must be re-attested by this date

retiringConditions.description: Conditions that would trigger retirement (label change, new evidence supersedes, etc.)

requiresMaReattestationAfterDays.description: Patient-facing cards need MA re-attestation if source approval > N days old

suggested: 1. Ideation Lead drafts card in Development lifecycle status
3. MA Team Lead approves → lifecycleStatus = Approved
5. If source document > 90 days old and card is patient-facing → require MA re-attestation before next publication
6. If claim currency changes (label update, new evidence) → lifecycleStatus = Superseded, new card issued
7. If retiring condition met → lifecycleStatus = Retired, removed from publishing calendar

qcChecklist: Core message + supporting evidence align — no orphan claim
Fair balance / limitations block is populated (not empty)
Suggested visual is specified where the message is quantitative
Primary source cited (CSR / SmPC / peer-reviewed publication)
